title: put.io Roku visual reference
description: Curated Roku screenshots captured from the app for review, store submission prep, and design comparison. Raw timestamped captures stay in dist/tmp; this directory keeps only public-safe references.

screenshots.title: Auth
notes: Auth screen with the activation code tiles redacted for public-safe review.
Captured from the live device before restoring the test account.
Recorded with the licensed GT America brand faces bundled.

screenshots.title: Home
notes: Home menu with Files, Search, History, and Settings visible.
Captured against the live test account after seeding a TV-visible history event.
Recorded with the licensed GT America brand faces bundled.

screenshots.title: History
notes: History page with a seeded transfer_completed event visible.
